title: Coyame lights around mountain peaks

tellings.quote: Locals constantly talk about colored lights that wink in and out around the mountain peaks.

plain: People living near Coyame, in the Mexican state of Chihuahua, often talk about colored lights that wink on and off around the mountain peaks. Michels repeats this from Mexico's Roswell, a book by the writers Noe Torres and Ruben Uriarte about a claimed UFO incident in the area. He tells it as part of why the region is seen as a hotspot for strange activity.
